Later, during the morning news on TV, a reporter standing next to the undamaged Heundeulbawi said, “Today’s Internet stories of the Heundeulbawi being damaged were fake.” Gina was embarrassed by the fact that she had spread the fake news.

윗글에서 지나의 감정과 그 이유를 바르게 연결한 것은?

Unfortunately, becoming an accidental distributor of fake news like Gina is not unusual. Fake news is a deliberate attempt to manipulate people by spreading inaccurate information. It is made by certain groups with the intention of attracting people’s attention, making profits, or gaining political benefits. It can confuse people, disturb society, and even seriously harm the public as well as all individuals involved.

윗글에서 가짜 뉴스를 만드는 목적으로 언급되지 않은 것은?
solution: 본문은 관심 유도, 수익 창출, 정치적 이득과 사람들에 대한 조종을 언급한다. 사회에 혼란을 준다는 설명을 공정한 의견 비교를 돕는다는 뜻으로 해석할 수는 없다.

다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.
It is very common for fake news to spread during states of emergency. For example, after an earthquake measuring 6.5 struck Ambon, Indonesia, in September 2019, thousands of residents did not return to their homes and were still in shelters for two weeks.

One of those messages said, “It’s up to you if you want to believe me or not, but apparently Ambon is going to sink in the next few days.” Many displaced people were so apprehensive about aftershocks that the government had to announce that the information was fake.

윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
solution: 정부는 해당 정보가 가짜라고 발표했으므로, 사실로 확인했다는 설명은 본문과 반대이다. 주민들이 대피소에 머물렀다는 사실과 소셜 미디어 메시지의 주장이 실제로 참이라는 판단은 구별해야 한다.

body:
다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.
You should question, analyze, and evaluate (A)[what / that] you read. Third, examine your biases. Consider if your own beliefs could affect your judgment. Ask (B)[you / yourself] if you are only reading articles that suit your opinion, and look for articles that oppose your opinion as well. Finally, check the credibility of the source. You should examine who wrote the news story and what the intent was behind writing the news story. solution: 과거 사실의 반대를 가정하는 가정법 과거완료이다. if절은 「had+p.p.」인 had given up, 주절은 '그런 성취가 일어날 수 없었을 것'이라는 부정 의미이므로 could not have occurred가 되어야 한다. 채점 기준: ①과 ② 각각 정확히 써야 득점(①은 had given up, ②는 could not have occurred/would not have occurred 인정), 시제·태·부정 중 하나라도 틀리면 해당 칸 오답.
source: 대치스파르타 프리미엄 · 2026 2학기 기말 시험대비 · 고1 공통영어2 YBM(박준언)
answer: ① had given up  ② could not have occurred
